known_as: Clara: ALREADY KNOWN - on the sheet (Financial Services & Payments, private) as Clara
detail: Mexican-founded spend-management fintech Clara raised USD 105M: a USD 65M Series C led by Citius, Kaszek and DEG plus a USD 40M renewal of a General Catalyst Customer Value Fund facility; valuation not disclosed; it plans to expand its Brazil sales team; LAVCA says it passed USD 100M ARR.
counterparty: Citius, Kaszek, DEG; General Catalyst CVF

known_as: Tamara: ALREADY KNOWN - on the sheet (Financial Services & Payments, private) as Tamara
detail: Saudi BNPL fintech Tamara added USD 400M of asset-backed DEBT facilities: a SAR 749M (about USD 200M) securitisation facility from MUFG and a USD 200M expansion of its Standard Chartered facility; no equity or valuation stated.

known_as: HUMAIN: ALREADY KNOWN - on the sheet (Software, Internet & AI, state-owned) as HUMAIN
detail: PIF and Aramco closed a deal in which Aramco (an F1 partner), through a wholly owned subsidiary, acquired 49% of HUMAIN for about SAR 9.9 billion (USD 2.6 billion) in cash during 2026 plus AI, compute and digital assets; PIF keeps 51%; valuation not stated.

known_as: HUMAIN: ALREADY KNOWN - on the sheet (Software, Internet & AI, state-owned) as HUMAIN
detail: HUMAIN acquired Riyadh-based cloud, data, AI and security services company CNTXT to expand its enterprise AI services; financial terms and ownership structure not disclosed.

known_as: Swile: ALREADY KNOWN - on the sheet (Financial Services & Payments, private) as Swile
detail: Swile plans to invest R$ 600 million in Brazil over five years, aiming to triple its Brazilian market share to 12-15% by 2030 and enter travel and expense management there in H1 2027; Brazil is about 25% of its global operation.
